title: SESSIONS: Interior – Six Blender Interior Scenes, Two Hours Each
raw_summary:
Interior is a project-based course about making beautiful interior renders in Blender, one focused scene at a time. Across six sessions, instructor Sascha Feider builds six complete vignettes from a default scene to a polished final image or animation: a sunlit staircase, a coffee corner, a flowing curtain, a marble colonnade, a cabin with a […]

Source
summary_fr: Cours complet Blender: 6 scènes intérieures en rendering professionnel.
analysis_fr:
- **Pépitre technique authentique**: cours structuré project-based (6 vignettes complètes, 2h chacune)
- Couvre pipeline complet: setup défaut → rendu final polish (shading, lighting, composition, animation rideau)
- Progression logique: escalier + coin café + rideaux + marbre + cabine = diversité technique
- Instructeur nommé (Sascha Feider) = accréditation expertise confirmée
- Combine multiple disciplines: modeling, texturing, lighting, dynamics (rideaux), camera work
- Valeur exceptionnelle pour motion designer cherchant maîtrise intérieur 3D et asset quality
- Format long-form = profondeur garantie vs shorts superficiels
